```python
import griffe

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience entry point
module = griffe.load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions
public_functions = []
for name, member in module.members.items():
    # Skip private members
    if name.startswith("_"):
        continue
    # Check if it's a function
    if isinstance(member, griffe.Function):
        public_functions.append(name)

# Print the names
for func_name in sorted(public_functions):
    print(func_name)
```
